title: Tribal students protest in Mumbai over school conditions and deaths
seoTitle: Mumbai protest over tribal school conditions

tea.why: Tribal students protested over deteriorating conditions in residential ashram schools and the reported deaths of 584 students.

tea.changed: Oct 25: Police detained around 120 tribal students and activists at Shivaji Park in Mumbai after denying permission for their demonstration.

summary: Tribal students and activists gathered at Shivaji Park in Mumbai to protest against deteriorating conditions in residential ashram schools and the reported deaths of 584 students. The participants demanded the resignations of Maharashtra tribal development minister Ashok Uike, the tribal development department commissioner, and the secretary, alongside an investigation into student deaths and improved hostel facilities. The agitation, which has been ongoing for two months, previously involved a 42-day sit-in in Nashik and a long march to Mumbai. Police heavily deployed personnel and detained approximately 120 protesters at Shivaji Park, describing the gathering as unauthorized. Students stated they plan to continue their agitation at Azad Maidan.
demands: Resignation of the tribal development minister, commissioner, and secretary
Inquiry into deaths in ashram schools
Better hostel facilities for tribal students
response: According to Deputy Commissioner of Police Mahendra Pandit, around 120 people who gathered at Shivaji Park for the unauthorized protest were taken to a police station, and release processes were underway. Police stated the gatherings were unauthorized.

arrests.text: around 120 tribal students who had gathered to demand the resignation

updates.text: An earlier demonstration ended with police detaining protesters and sending them back to Nashik, Nandurbar, and Jalgaon.
